content:
**Chicken Noodle Soup** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A Chicken Thigh that has been cooked in water. It gives a 30 minute boost to Disease Resistance while restoring a large amount of HP and a moderate amount of hunger and thirst at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Chicken Thigh (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Chicken Thigh | | Chicken Noodle Soup (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up a chicken thigh for the first time.
- May be sold by Mr Waiter and Ms Waitress inside the Whitespring Resort.
- A 50% chance to be found outside Site Charlie, Pleasant Valley Ski Resort, and Clancy Manor.
